name: Data Structures
description: Learn how information is organized, stored, and processed efficiently.

syllabus.title: Foundations and Linear Structures
syllabus.summary: Abstract data types, complexity, arrays, linked lists, stacks, and queues.

syllabus.title: Non-linear Structures
syllabus.summary: Hierarchical and network relationships using trees and graphs.

syllabus.title: Algorithms
syllabus.summary: Core techniques for finding and ordering data.

name: Database Management Systems
description: Design reliable databases and use queries to work with structured data.

syllabus.title: Database Foundations
syllabus.summary: Data models, schemas, keys, and entity relationships.

syllabus.title: Relational Design
syllabus.summary: Functional dependencies and normalization for clean table design.

syllabus.title: Transactions and Performance
syllabus.summary: Reliable changes, indexes, and safe concurrent access.

name: Machine Learning
description: Understand how models learn useful patterns from examples.

syllabus.title: Learning Basics
syllabus.summary: Features, labels, training data, and the machine learning workflow.

syllabus.title: Core Models
syllabus.summary: Regression, classification, clustering, and practical model selection.

name: Artificial Intelligence
description: Explore search, reasoning, knowledge representation, and intelligent agents.

syllabus.title: Intelligent Agents
syllabus.summary: How agents perceive environments, choose actions, and pursue goals.

syllabus.title: Search and Reasoning
syllabus.summary: Strategies for finding solutions and representing knowledge.

name: Computer Networks
description: Understand how devices communicate across connected systems.

syllabus.title: Transport and Applications
syllabus.summary: Reliable delivery and common application protocols.

name: Operating Systems
description: Study the software layer that manages processors, memory, and devices.

syllabus.title: Processes and Threads
syllabus.summary: Program execution, concurrency, and CPU scheduling.

syllabus.title: Memory and Storage
syllabus.summary: Virtual memory, allocation, files, and storage devices.

name: Python Programming
description: Build practical programming foundations with readable, expressive Python.

syllabus.title: Python Foundations
syllabus.summary: Syntax, values, control flow, and reusable functions.

syllabus.title: Data and Programs
syllabus.summary: Collections, objects, errors, and working with files.
